title: RBI Governance Directions for NBFCs (updated 24 Jun 2026)

items.obligation: Adopt Board-approved policies for fit and proper status of directors, Chief Compliance Officer duties, compensation, and Board reviews.
items.detail: Applies to Middle Layer and Upper Layer NBFCs as specified in paragraphs 12, 25(2), 29, and 15.

items.obligation: Ensure at least one director has relevant experience working in a bank or an NBFC.
Constitute a Risk Management Committee at the Board or executive level to evaluate overall risks including liquidity risk.
items.detail: The committee must report directly to the Board.

items.obligation: Obtain prior written approval of RBI for management changes resulting in more than 30 percent director changes.
items.detail: Excludes independent directors and directors re-elected on retirement by rotation. Must inform RBI/NHB of any changes regardless of threshold.

timing.due: prior to change resulting in >30% replacement
timing.trigger: Proposed management change exceeding 30% of directors

items.obligation: Submit application for change in management to RBI through the PRAVAAH portal with required documents.
items.detail: Application must be on company letterhead accompanied by Annex I and specified portal documents.

items.obligation: Establish a Board-approved policy and internal process to conduct continuous fit and proper due diligence of directors.
items.detail: Applies at appointment and on a continuing basis.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs, NBFC-AA, NBFC-P2P

items.obligation: Obtain Annex II declaration from proposed/existing directors and ensure scrutiny by Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
items.detail: Must check suitability based on qualification, expertise, integrity, and track record.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs, NBFC-AA, NBFC-P2P

items.obligation: Ensure Nomination and Remuneration Committee scrutinizes director declarations to decide on acceptance.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs, NBFC-AA, NBFC-P2P

items.obligation: Obtain an annual simple declaration from all directors confirming no change in previously furnished information.
items.detail: Directors must furnish details forthwith if there is any change.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs, NBFC-AA, NBFC-P2P

items.obligation: Require directors to execute Deeds of Covenants in the format specified in Annex III.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs, NBFC-AA, NBFC-P2P

items.obligation: Submit quarterly statements on director changes and MD/CEO certification of fit and proper criteria to RBI or NHB.
items.detail: Must reach RBI/NHB Regional Office within 15 days of quarter end. March 31 quarter statement must be certified by auditors.

timing.due: within 15 days of the close of each quarter

items.obligation: Submit periodic reviews on risk management framework and corporate governance standards to the Board of Directors.
items.detail: Covers progress in risk strategy and compliance with committee composition, roles, and meeting frequency.

timing.due: at periodic intervals prescribed by the Board

items.obligation: Delineate clearly the specific roles and responsibilities of all Board committees.
Constitute an Audit Committee consisting of at least three Board members with powers under Section 177 of Companies Act 2013.
items.detail: If already formed under Companies Act Section 177, that committee satisfies this requirement.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs, NBFC-AA

items.obligation: Ensure Audit Committee mandates Information System Audit of internal systems as per RBI Outsourcing Directions.
items.detail: Conducted to assess operational risks faced by the NBFC.

timing.due: as per periodicity prescribed in RBI Outsourcing Directions

items.obligation: Form a Nomination and Remuneration Committee with powers and duties specified in Section 178 of Companies Act 2013.
items.detail: Government-owned NBFCs shall form a Nomination Committee instead to ensure fit and proper status of directors.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs, NBFC-AA

items.obligation: Appoint a Chief Risk Officer with clearly specified roles and responsibilities.
items.detail: Applies to NBFCs with asset size exceeding ₹5,000 crore.

items.obligation: Ensure Chief Risk Officer holds a senior position and possesses adequate professional qualifications and experience in risk management.
Establish Board policies safeguarding independent functioning of CRO, direct reporting lines, and prohibiting dual hatting or business targets.
items.detail: CRO reports to MD&CEO or RMCB. If reporting to MD&CEO, RMC/Board must meet CRO without MD&CEO quarterly. No business vertical reporting or targets.

timing.due: at least quarterly for RMC/Board meeting without MD&CEO

items.obligation: Obtain Board approval for CRO appointment and premature removal, and report any early transfer/removal to RBI/NHB and stock exchanges.
items.detail: Report to RBI/NHB Regional Office. Listed NBFCs must also report any change in CRO incumbency to stock exchanges.

timing.trigger: Premature transfer or removal of Chief Risk Officer

items.obligation: Involve Chief Risk Officer in risk identification and ensure all retail and wholesale credit proposals are vetted by CRO.
items.detail: CRO's role in deciding credit proposals shall be limited to advisory.

items.obligation: Ensure CRO has voting power if serving as decision maker in committee credit sanctioning, making all members jointly and severally liable.
items.detail: Applies to high value proposals sanctioned via committee approach where CRO is a decision maker.
items.appliesTo: NBFCs with asset size > ₹5,000 crore using committee credit sanction

items.obligation: Appoint a Chief Compliance Officer of sufficient seniority and adopt a Board-approved policy detailing CCO roles and responsibilities.
items.detail: Objective is to build a strong compliance risk management framework and culture.

items.obligation: Prohibit Key Managerial Personnel from holding any office or directorship in any other Middle or Upper Layer NBFC.
items.detail: Exception allowed for directorships held in subsidiaries or Base Layer NBFCs.

items.obligation: Restrict independent directors from holding Board positions in more than three Middle or Upper Layer NBFCs simultaneously.
items.detail: Restriction does not apply to directorships in Base Layer NBFCs.

items.obligation: Ensure no conflict of interest arises from an independent director sitting on the Board of another NBFC concurrently.
Adopt and adhere to a Board-approved compensation policy for KMP and Senior Management containing fixed/variable pay structures and malus/clawback provisions.
items.detail: Not applicable to Government owned NBFCs.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs (except Government owned)

items.obligation: Mandate Nomination and Remuneration Committee to oversee framing, review, and implementation of Board-approved compensation policy.
items.detail: Not applicable to Government owned NBFCs.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs (except Government owned)

items.obligation: Ensure NRC coordinates with RMC, aligns compensation with capital/ICAAP requirements, and verifies fit and proper status avoiding conflicts.
items.detail: NRC must ensure compensation levels support retained earnings and capital adequacy.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs (except Government owned)

items.obligation: Ensure compensation policy fully complies with all statutory mandates, rules, and directions.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs (except Government owned)

items.obligation: Structure reasonable compensation packages for KMP and Senior Management aligned with risk outcomes, time horizons, and prudent risk taking.
items.detail: Must balance fixed and variable pay, ensuring cash/equity mix is symmetric with risk outcomes.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs (except Government owned)

items.obligation: Include perquisites with monetary ceilings, retiral contributions, and monetary equivalents of non-monetary benefits inside fixed pay.
items.detail: Reimbursable perquisites must have monetary ceilings to be included in fixed pay.
items.appliesTo: Middle and Upper Layer NBFCs (except Government owned)

items.obligation: Ensure compensation of variable pay for KMP and senior management adheres to statutory provisions and proper performance structures.
items.detail: Variable pay may be cash, share-linked, or a mix; must be reducible to zero based on performance; performance measures must be clearly defined at the start of the period.

items.obligation: Establish deferral arrangements for variable pay of KMP and senior management based on risk horizons.
items.detail: Deferral applies to cash and non-cash components; deferral period is decided by the Board.

items.obligation: Compensate financial control, risk management, compliance, and internal audit personnel independently from the business areas they oversee.
items.detail: Personnel may have a higher proportion of fixed compensation, with reasonable variable pay to allow malus/clawback execution.

items.obligation: Refrain from paying guaranteed bonus to KMP and senior management.
items.detail: Sign-on or joining bonus for new hires is permitted but cannot be treated as part of fixed or variable pay.

items.obligation: Subject deferred compensation of KMP and senior management to malus and clawback arrangements.
items.detail: Identify representative situations for invoking malus/clawback covering the entire variable pay; set application period covering at least deferral and retention periods.

items.obligation: Formulate a whistle blower mechanism for directors and employees to report genuine concerns.
Ensure good corporate governance practices in the subsidiaries of the NBFC.
items.detail: Board of the NBFC is responsible for ensuring governance practices in subsidiaries.

items.obligation: Frame internal guidelines on corporate governance with Board approval and publish them on the company website.
items.detail: Guidelines must enhance the scope of the Directions without sacrificing their spirit.

items.obligation: Ensure the Board composition has an appropriate mix of educational qualifications, experience, and specific expertise.
items.detail: Expertise required depends on the type of business pursued by the NBFC.

items.obligation: Report to supervisors if any Independent Director resigns or is removed before completing normal tenure.

timing.trigger: Removal or premature resignation of an Independent Director

items.obligation: List mandatorily on a stock exchange within three years of identification as NBFC-UL and implement listed-entity disclosures prior to listing.
items.detail: Not applicable to NBFC-UL fully owned and controlled by the Government.

timing.due: within three years of identification in the Upper Layer

items.obligation: Obtain completed information forms from proposed directors prior to their appointment.
items.detail: Form requires personal details, experience, shareholding, directorships, regulatory actions, and economic offense disclosures (Annex I).

items.obligation: Obtain signed Declaration and Undertaking from each director regarding fit and proper criteria.
items.detail: Director undertakes to inform the NBFC of subsequent changes and execute Deed of Covenants (Annex II).

timing.due: as soon as possible upon relevant events
timing.trigger: Appointment of Director or occurrence of subsequent relevant events

items.obligation: Execute a Deed of Covenants with every director upon their appointment.
items.detail: Form of Deed of Covenants lays out obligations, fiduciary duties, and company disclosures (Annex III).

items.obligation: Apprise directors of Board procedures, control systems, corporate policies, legal duties, and regulatory updates.
items.detail: NBFC must inform directors on voting rights, committee charters, insider trading rules, executive powers, and appoint a compliance officer.

items.obligation: Provide required disclosures and relevant information to all directors to enable informed decision-making.
items.detail: Disclosures must include strategic plans, updates on products, major expenditure, organizational structure, performance reviews, and strategic initiative reports.

items.obligation: Circulate Board meeting minutes to directors in a timely manner.
items.detail: Communicate outcomes and circulate minutes to directors to the extent possible within two business days of the conclusion of the Board meeting.

timing.due: within two business days of the date of conclusion of the Board meeting

items.obligation: Advise each director about the levels of authority delegated in matters placed before the Board.
Provide periodic reports to directors regarding the functioning and effectiveness of the internal control system.
Appoint a senior executive as Compliance Officer reporting directly to the Board.
items.detail: The officer is responsible for setting policies/procedures and monitoring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and RBI directions.

items.obligation: Ensure directors do not assign, transfer, sublet, or encumber their office, rights, or obligations to third parties.
items.detail: Subject to applicable laws and Articles of Association regarding Board delegation.

items.obligation: Execute any amendments to the Deed of Covenants in writing and signed by both parties.
items.detail: Deed must be executed in duplicate, with both copies deemed originals.

timing.trigger: amendment or supplement to Deed of Covenants
